### Observed differences

- Before, every trace contained A34, A35, A36 and A37; in the later window each of them appears in only about 47–56 in 100 traces (A34 about 56, A35 about 56, A36 about 47, A37 about 47). [OCC005, OCC006, OCC007, OCC008]
- The four activities split into two self-contained pairs that became mutually exclusive: A34 still co-occurs with A35 in essentially every trace where either appears (100 → about 56 in 100) and A36 with A37 (100 → about 46 in 100), but cross-pair co-occurrence collapsed from 100 in 100 traces to about 2–3 in 100. [REL025, REL026, REL027, REL028, REL029, REL030]
- The framing activities are preserved: A30 still precedes and A31 still follows whichever pair runs, in every co-occurring case, and A30 and A31 themselves still appear in all traces. [REL017, REL018, REL019, REL020, REL021, REL022, REL023, REL024]
- The segment between them shrank and was rewired: the A30→A31 distance fell from 5 steps in almost every case to 3 steps in about 93 in 100; A30 now leads directly to A36 or A37 in about 44 in 100 of its outgoing transitions (previously never observed) and A34/A35 lead directly to A31 in about 46–50 in 100 (previously essentially never), while the old A34/A35 → A36/A37 step remains in only about 3 in 200 after-traces. [LAG003, LAG004, LAG005, LAG006, LAG008, DIR003, DIR004, DIR005, LAG007, LAG009]
- A06 now appears in about 10 in 100 traces (before about 30 in 100) and therefore often shares no trace with A34–A37 any more (no common trace in about 41–48 in 100 cases). [OCC003, REL005, REL006, REL007, REL008]
- The rare activities A02, A04 and A08 became more frequent (A02 from about 2–3 to 13 in 100 traces; A04 and A08 from about 1 to 7 in 100 each, on few traces), and A15 and A43 gained small new outgoing edges to them (roughly 1–2 in 100 of their transitions). [OCC001, OCC002, OCC004, DIR002, DIR006]
- A15, A16, A30, A34 and A35 now occur slightly later within their traces (for example A30's mean relative position moves from about 0.65 to 0.70). [POS001, POS002, POS003, POS004, POS005]

### Inference

Support level: Supported hypothesis

The evidence supports the hypothesis that the segment between A30 and A31 — the A34/A35 pair followed by the A36/A37 pair — changed from a mandatory four-activity block into an optional either/or choice: before, all four activities ran in every case as one block (each pair in either internal order); in the later window each case runs only one of the two pairs (A34+A35 in about 55 in 100 cases, A36+A37 in about 47 in 100), A30 still precedes and A31 still follows the chosen pair, and the A30→A31 distance shrinks from 5 to 3 steps. This rests on direct participation, co-occurrence, successor and gap evidence that all show the same restructure, with 33 qualifying items against roughly 1 expected if nothing had changed and every item exceeding about 995 of 1,000 random re-splits; the main limitations are that the evidence cannot show what determines which pair is chosen, and it cannot rule out that the later window simply mixes two case populations (a full and a shortened variant) rather than a within-case routing change. [OCC005, OCC006, OCC007, OCC008, REL025, REL026, REL027, REL028, REL029, REL030, REL017, REL021, REL023, LAG003, DIR003, DIR004, DIR005]

Other differences: A06 participation fell from about 30 to 10 in 100 traces and it now rarely overlaps the A34–A37 group; A02, A04 and A08 became more frequent, with new small outgoing edges from A15 and A43; A15, A16, A30, A34 and A35 sit slightly later within traces. [OCC003, REL005, REL007, OCC001, OCC002, OCC004, DIR002, DIR006, POS001, POS002, POS003, POS004, POS005]
